texts.zh: 我们在[target.capital_scope.GetName]上已逐步整合了当地[target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的数个关键节点中心。目标是让当地蜂巢在日常活动中对我们更加依赖，并让我们可以最终无缝吞并他们的星球。渗透单位正在巩固我们在[target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]上的进度。什么时候动手完全取决于我们自己。
texts.en: We have slowly assimilated multiple key nodal centers from the local [target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [target.capital_scope.GetName]. The goal is to make the local hive more reliant on us for their day-to-day activities until we can seamlessly annex their world. Infiltration cells are now consolidating our efforts on the [target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]. The time to act is upon us.

texts.zh: 我们对[target.capital_scope.GetName]的渗透几乎已经完成了，整个[root.target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]上几乎所有部分的节点都已经被我们同化。我们已经接管了这里的许多日常活动。很快我们就能准备好完全整合他们。
texts.en: Our infiltration of [target.capital_scope.GetName] is nigh on absolute, as we have assimilated nodes of every facet all over the [root.target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]. We have taken over many of the day-to-day activities of the world. Soon we will be ready to integrate them fully.

texts.zh:
即使[target.capital_scope.GetName]地表有无数的节点中枢处于我们的控制之下，但进度仍旧缓慢。尝试完全整合一个原始的大陆蜂巢成为了一场灾难，而我们在当地的特工也被驱逐了。

多亏了我们的多项包括持续回收子个体在内的应急措施，才让遗骸和我们在这颗星球上的工作避免暴露。
texts.en:
Even with numerous nodal centers under our control on the surface of [target.capital_scope.GetName], progress has been slow. An attempt to fully assimilate a primary continental hive ended in disaster and the expulsion of all our local operatives.

It was only due to our multiple contingency efforts that we kept the recycling drones from recovering the remains and exposing our work on the planet.
